# Rhinvoice

> Rhinvoice is a free, open-source invoicing program for small businesses in Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Germany and Austria. It writes quotes, invoices, cancellation invoices and payment reminders with the VAT rules, legal notices, payment codes and e-invoice formats of each of these four countries. It runs on the user's own computer or server, as a program for Windows and Mac or with Docker, is licensed under the GNU AGPL v3, and made by webberz, a software company in Balgach in the Swiss Rhine Valley.

## Facts

- Name: Rhinvoice (from Rhine and invoice: the Rhine connects Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Austria and Germany)
- Website: https://rhinvoice.com/ (English), https://rhinvoice.com/de/ (German), https://rhinvoice.com/fr/ (French), https://rhinvoice.com/it/ (Italian)
- Source code: https://github.com/rhinvoice/rhinvoice
- Licence: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 or later (AGPL-3.0); contributions under a contributor licence agreement
- Price: free; there is no paid version and no hosted service
- Countries of the issuing company: Switzerland (CH), Liechtenstein (LI), Germany (DE), Austria (AT); customers can be anywhere; more company countries can be added as country profiles
- Languages: interface in German (Swiss, German and Austrian variants), French, Italian (both machine translated) and English; documents in German, English, French or Italian (French and Italian as written in Switzerland)
- Runs on: a program for Windows 10/11 (x64) and for Macs with Apple silicon (macOS 12 or later), with the database included, updates in the program and backups into a folder such as OneDrive or iCloud Drive (beta); or Docker on Linux, macOS or Windows (servers, NAS, Raspberry Pi 4/5, laptops with Docker Desktop), images for amd64 and arm64
- Status: beta (0.x)
- Made by: webberz, Balgach, Switzerland (https://www.webberz.ch/)

## What Rhinvoice does

- **Documents:** quotes, invoices and cancellation invoices with a live paper preview; numbers assigned without gaps when a document is issued; issued documents cannot be changed (GoBD, Swiss OR 958f, Austrian BAO), corrections only by cancellation.
- **VAT per country:** dated rates for CH, LI, DE and AT; the tax treatment (domestic, reverse charge, intra-Community supply of goods, export, small business, exempt) follows from the countries of company and customer, with the legally required notice on the invoice; goods and services are treated separately.
- **Payment codes:** Swiss QR-bill (QR or creditor reference) for Switzerland and Liechtenstein; EPC QR code (GiroCode) for euro invoices.
- **E-invoices:** ZUGFeRD / Factur-X (EN 16931) embedded in every PDF (PDF/A-3b); XRechnung 3.0 for German public authorities; validated with the KoSIT validator and Mustang.
- **Payments and reminders:** partial payments, overdue invoices, three reminder levels with fees.
- **Recurring invoices:** monthly, quarterly, half-yearly or yearly, as draft, issued, or issued and sent.
- **E-mail:** sending documents through the company's own mail server (SMTP).
- **Import:** customers and articles from CSV and Excel, and old invoices of the previous program with their original PDFs.
- **Backups:** encrypted, deduplicated backups with restic to S3, SFTP, a folder, Dropbox or Google Drive; the program for Windows and Mac backs up into a folder of the user's choice (OneDrive, Dropbox, iCloud Drive, Google Drive, a network drive or a USB disk).
- **Updates:** the program says when a newer version exists; on Windows and Mac one click installs it and takes it back if it does not start. The check fetches a signed release.json from GitHub once a day and can be switched off.
- **Security:** login with optional two-factor authentication; a forgotten password is reset by the administrator on a server, or with a one-time code in the program's data folder on Windows and Mac; data stays with the user.

## What Rhinvoice is not

- Not a hosted service or SaaS: everyone runs it on their own server or computer. A hosted version is only conceivable if the community asks for it and sponsors carry the running costs.
- Not an accounting program: no bookkeeping, no ledger, no VAT returns, no payroll.
- Not tax advice: rates and rules are checked against official sources (ESTV, Liechtenstein tax administration, German and Austrian ministries of finance) and provided without warranty.
- Not for countries other than CH, LI, DE and AT as the issuing company's country yet; new countries can be added as country profiles (see the guide below).
- Not a web shop or point-of-sale system.

## Install

On Windows or a Mac, without Docker (beta): download the setup and start it.

- Windows 10/11: https://github.com/rhinvoice/rhinvoice/releases/latest/download/Rhinvoice-Setup-Windows.exe
- Mac with Apple silicon, macOS 12 or later: https://github.com/rhinvoice/rhinvoice/releases/latest/download/Rhinvoice-macOS.dmg

The setups are signed by the developer, the Mac app is also notarized by Apple. While the Windows certificate is new, Windows SmartScreen may still ask once ("More info" → "Run anyway").

On a server, a NAS or your own computer with Docker:

```bash
mkdir rhinvoice && cd rhinvoice
curl -fsSLO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rhinvoice/rhinvoice/main/deploy/compose.yml
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rhinvoice/rhinvoice/main/.env.example -o .env
# in .env, set POSTGRES_PASSWORD to a long random value
docker compose pull
docker compose up -d
```

Then open http://rhinvoice.localhost:8000; the first visit sets up the first user.

## Demo

Public demos, reset every hour, one per country:

- Switzerland: https://ch.rhinvoice.com
- Germany: https://de.rhinvoice.com
- Austria: https://at.rhinvoice.com

All visitors share one login per demo; it sends no e-mail and takes no uploads (imports are switched off there).

## Documentation

The user documentation, in English (https://rhinvoice.com/docs/) and German (https://rhinvoice.com/docs/de/, same paths below /docs/de/). Also in French (https://rhinvoice.com/docs/fr/) and Italian (https://rhinvoice.com/docs/it/), machine-translated, with the same paths. Its sitemap: https://rhinvoice.com/docs/sitemap-index.xml

- [What is Rhinvoice?](https://rhinvoice.com/docs/getting-started/what-is-rhinvoice/)
- [Install on Windows or Mac](https://rhinvoice.com/docs/getting-started/install-desktop/): one setup, no Docker (beta)
- [Installation with Docker](https://rhinvoice.com/docs/getting-started/installation/): Docker Compose, first user, HTTPS
- [Your first invoice](https://rhinvoice.com/docs/getting-started/first-invoice/)
- [Switzerland](https://rhinvoice.com/docs/countries/switzerland/): MWST rates, QR-bill, mandatory details
- [Liechtenstein](https://rhinvoice.com/docs/countries/liechtenstein/)
- [Germany](https://rhinvoice.com/docs/countries/germany/): USt., § 14 UStG, small businesses, GiroCode, e-invoice obligation
- [Austria](https://rhinvoice.com/docs/countries/austria/): USt., § 11 UStG, small businesses, GiroCode
- [More countries](https://rhinvoice.com/docs/countries/more-countries/): Rhinvoice is built to be extended; each company country is one country profile (rates, notices, mandatory details, sources), e.g. the Netherlands
- [E-invoices](https://rhinvoice.com/docs/invoices/e-invoice/): ZUGFeRD / Factur-X and XRechnung
- [Taking over old invoices](https://rhinvoice.com/docs/moving/old-invoices/): from the previous program, with the original PDFs
- [Backup and restore](https://rhinvoice.com/docs/operations/backup/)
- [Backup in the program for Windows and Mac](https://rhinvoice.com/docs/operations/backup-desktop/)
- [Updating](https://rhinvoice.com/docs/operations/update/)
- [Frequently asked questions](https://rhinvoice.com/docs/help/faq/)
